evidence: Current sources read/edited only. No builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game/JNI/shader/GPU execution, process inspection or exports.

input.field: WorldFrame.Player.javaWingGlint, optional explicit target-Java input object; parsed once into immutable GlintSample. Omission/null remains unknown and does not mean no glint.
input.inactive: Exactly schema=1 and selected=false. This records an explicitly absent selected pass, not an alpha-zero or strength-zero approximation.
input.active: Exactly eight fields: numeric schema=1, literal boolean selected=true, textureMatrix (16 column-major floats), fogPosition (12 row-major affine floats), colorModulator (4 floats), fogRanges (4 floats), glintAlpha (float in 0..1), and actual submitted Java viewTranslation (3 floats). Numeric values must be finite; fog ranges ordered. No clock, speed, strength, transform or pose is inferred from native enchantment/glow/forced-glint flags.
input.validation: Strict JSON primitive/array types and field count; no string-to-boolean/number coercion. Active input requires the existing declared layered camera. A copied empty chest or known Java hasFoil=false conflicts with active glint and is rejected. HasFoil=true alone never selects or constructs a pass.
input.ownership: Copies 40 active floats; same/copy/archive helpers retain exact float values. The parsed input is neither an installed-game receipt nor new native suppression/renderer authority. Existing native glint/wing feature gates remain.
input.producer: An authoritative installed-game adapter supplying these target-Java selection/uniform/pose observations remains missing. No live producer was synthesized.

archive.sample: u8 1 for explicit inactive or 2 for active; active then stores 40 f32 values in textureMatrix16, fogPosition12, colorModulator4, fogRanges4, glintAlpha1, viewTranslation3 order. Unknown actors have no map entry; state 0/other inside an entry is rejected.
archive.frame: time f64, native tick i64, tick rate f32, strict context-presence u8, optional context, actor count u16, then sorted UUID i64/i64 plus sample entries. Context is present exactly when at least one actor has an active sample.
archive.context: Bounded dimension via DataOutput UTF, strict position-space byte, six f64 camera values, sixteen f32 world projection values and sixteen f32 layered equipment projection values. Copies are owned; active playback requires exact context equality.
archive.writer: GlintHistory.Writer participates in the existing appearance recording begin/observe/finish lifecycle and serialized appendTrack queue. It observes explicit samples only for complete model observations with equipped wings, wing matrices and part matrices. All-unknown 64-frame blocks are omitted as gaps. Backward time/ticks or changed data without timeline advancement fail the recording rather than overwrite observations.
archive.reader: Optional track mounted by ReplayAppearance. Validate the complete index and every block before mount; 1..4096 chunks, 1..64 frames/chunk, finite bounded ordered clocks, 128 actors/frame, strict selection/context flags, unique actors, complete index/time agreement and no trailing bytes. Compressed/inflated input is bounded to 2 MiB blocks plus compressed overhead; reject incomplete/trailing compressed streams. Two-block LRU rechecks the source manifest before lazy reads.
archive.budget: Reserve 16 MiB for the glint reader and keep a bounded aggregate appearance preparation budget of 128 MiB (previously 80 MiB), allowing the added reader alongside existing track reservations/assets. The existing VM heap setting is unchanged. This is an admission budget, not measured runtime memory.
archive.compatibility: Existing archives without this track still mount with unknown glint data; no inactive pass is fabricated. New track data needs a reader that recognizes this kind. Other track and ARCGEO01..09 wire layouts do not change.

sampling.entry: ReplayAppearance.wingGlint and BedrockPlatform.recordedWingGlint resolve the recorded actor at exactTime and query this track only. The live viewer's profile/clock/options are never queried as fallback.
sampling.exact: Exact observations return owned copies. Active data requires exact dimension, position space, camera, world projection and layered projection agreement. Known inactive data carries no transform and can survive camera edits.
sampling.interior: Return only identical selected inputs across contiguous observations with at most one tick and the existing bounded observation interval. Active endpoints additionally need identical camera contexts and a matching viewer context. Missing actors/blocks, changed selection/uniforms/poses, long gaps or incompatible cameras return unknown.
sampling.noReconstruction: V1 stores actual selected transforms, not an assumed Java Util clock-rate model. Animated changing matrices are not linearly blended across wraps, extrapolated, held through gaps or regenerated from viewer time. Camera-dependent view poses/fog are not guessed under camera edits.
sampling.status: wingGlintTrackAvailable and lastWingGlintSampleError describe data availability. wingGlintPlaybackVerified stays false; no new render-ready or parity assertion is introduced.
